name: data-capture-flow-compare
description: Compare Salesforce Data Capture Flow versions in VS Code and Cursor — org retrieve, XML diff, and structured change summary.

commands.title: Data Capture Flow: Compare from Org (Same or Across Orgs)
Data Capture Flow: Compare Two Local Flow Files
Data Capture Flow: Show Structured Change Summary
Data Capture Flow: Export Last Report

dcFlowCompare.targetOrg.description: Default Salesforce CLI org alias for same-org compares. Empty = CLI default org. Cross-org compare always prompts for both orgs.

dcFlowCompare.onlyDataCaptureFlows.description: When listing flows from the org, only show processType = DataCaptureFlow. Turn off to compare any Flow type.

dcFlowCompare.ignoreLayoutNoise.description: Ignore locationX/locationY differences in fingerprints and the structured change summary.

dcFlowCompare.ignoreProcessMetadata.description: Ignore processMetadataValues (Flow Builder canvas metadata) in fingerprints and the structured change summary.
